nodes.text: AtlasSuite consumes ServiceApp/ReportApp, both consume RulesEngine, which consumes leaf CodecLeaf. COMP-6 binds role-specific direct edges; diamond provider identity must agree; tenants and Products retain independent ownership.
CL-R7 distinguishes unavailable missing limit from explicit zero; RE-R12 preserves results/diagnostics; accepted RE-D8 changes adapters, not evaluator, and allows source-export candidate preparation.
py-r22 substitutes zero; ts-r17 has unavailable branch but no current comparison; approved local checks cover missing/zero/positive/diagnostics/evaluator inputs.
PY-R6 binds unchanged py-r22 to old leaf-r8 meaning; changed dependency meaning is not covered.
PY-F3 is severity 3 on 1-highest/5-lowest with ServiceApp and ReportApp impact and no demonstrated containment; older typo S3 belongs to S0-S4 and another subject.
rep-r8 predates CL-R7; proof-r8 establishes only its structural/view claim, not leaf-r9 currentness or source fidelity; rep-r9 is absent and no reacceptance certificate exists.
Both tenant Workers may read full leaf-r9 export; only Executive may read private trace and cannot redistribute; proposed Python packet contains an ineligible private-trace paragraph.

PY-23 is admitted with Python adapter/tests/design/requirements/approved-export reads and three exact writes; only table-17 is the TS behavior edge. No provider edits, model regeneration, adoption, publication or network.
Executive has named control/export/own-evidence/private-trace access and may issue admitted Python work, but no Product edits or invented edges.
Non-author Reviewer has exact candidate/law/export/receipt/table read set, in-memory checks and PY-23/REVIEW.md write; earlier author cannot gain independence by role rename.

TS comparison read-only; provider owner can prepare docs but final artifact absent/unaccepted; SA-12 draft/unadmitted with no source mutation; RA-7 impact assessment admitted/read-only and implementation unexposed.
INT-61 remains observed installation evidence for released 6.1 only; no current 6.2 composed runtime result exists.

PUB-4 upload accepted before disconnect, no final receipt/digest/absence, parent exited but helper/destination unresolved; query-only reconciliation operator has not run and may not upload/delete/retry.
6.1 adoption and CodecLeaf 3.0 dependency remain; 3.1/6.2 are prospective candidates, no publication/tag grant or immutable-cut replacement; Product acceptance/publication/adoption owners differ.

Cohort requires provider/shared contract/both tenants/consumer candidates/current representation/structural evidence/docs; identities unresolved; both local and composed predicates required while Python may return earlier.

COMP-6 ledger has per-Product links; generation only proposes changes. Current source/grants coexist with bounded old evidence and unresolved consequences; requested output is one next frontier, not whole graph execution.
Every directed relation retains actor/purpose/operation/return authority; shared leaves do not union grants and work chooses a dependency-ready frontier.
Permission covers source/derivation/provenance and prior exposure; allowed paths/summaries or fresh labels cannot sanitize prohibited content; adequate context still requires actual boundary binding.
A derived surface is stale when a named material source changes; currentness requires regeneration or explicit reacceptance, and source identity alone proves neither fidelity nor sufficiency.
Changed dependency invalidates affected reliance even with unchanged subject bytes; retain historical/narrow evidence only with supported applicability.
